description: E12 stress requests, added to P1's five. wide-16q is the widest fork the deployment runs (N_SEQ=17: the state plus 16 question sequences) over a long state, so it writes far more K/V cells and recurrent rows than any other request. The short requests after it in a shuffled order then run on cells it left behind. short-1q and short-1q-b are single-question requests (the dec_eval path, one sequence); pair-2q is a two-question fork.
